question: Which species of mangrove tree found in the Sunderbans of India and Bangladesh is scientifically known as 'Heritiera formes'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sundari.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sundari** is scientifically known as **Heritiera fomes.**
 
• Sundari is a **mangrove species **found in the** Sundarbans of India** and **Bangladesh.**
 
• It is an important species for the ecosystem as it provides habitat to a** variety of fauna** and helps in** protecting the coast from natural disasters** such as cyclones and tsunamis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kachnar **is a flowering tree found in **India and Southeast Asia.**

 
 
• Because of its** anti-inflammatory and antioxidant **characteristics, kachnar promotes the **growth of new skin cells,** which aids in the healing of wounds.​
 
 
 
• **Kusum **is a deciduous tree found in **India, Nepal, and Bangladesh.**
 
 
• **​**The tree is known as **Schleichera oleosa.**
 
 
 
• **Arjun **is a medicinal tree species found in** India and Sri Lanka.**
